purpose: Round 3C freshness impact review for /anime-expeditions/tier-list. Records which sources were re-read after the 2026-11-05 evidence snapshot, what actually changed, and whether any published ranking was affected.

datesAreDistinct.note: The snapshot date is the newest source revision actually reconciled. The review date is when the pass ran. lastModified only records that the page changed; it is never used as evidence that the evidence is current.

sources.name: Pro Game Guides — Update 5 tier list and six-unit team cores
sources.whatChanged: Publisher note: 'Updated on November 8, 2026: Added Emerald Fist and refreshed all Update 4 and 5 unit evaluations with full upgrade stats, total costs, and current ability details.' The page also clarifies Dead Melody's summon-selection restriction: summons and clones are ignored when a melody is chosen and cannot become Captain.
sources.basis: Every published Overall tier was reconciled against the 2026-11-08 revision. 75 of 77 units appear in that revision and all 75 agree; 0 disagreements. Published tier-bucket counts match the source exactly (S 32, A 23, B 9, C 5, D 6).
sources.correction: The previous snapshot attributed Emerald Fist's comparative baseline to the 2026-11-02 revision, but the publisher only added Emerald Fist on 2026-11-08. Refreshing the baseline to 2026-11-08 makes that attribution truthful rather than retroactive.

sources.name: MrGuider — Update 5 role ranking cross-check
sources.whatChanged: None. The page is still dated November 1, 2026 and still states that the five Update 5 units 'will be ranked soon'.
sources.basis: Used only as a page-level role cross-check. No unit record attaches it as its own ranking evidence, so no per-unit claim depends on it.

sources.name: Community role ranking
sources.whatChanged: None. Revision 9561 predates Update 5 · Hallows Eve.
sources.basis: It corroborates role reads on 13 units but cannot certify a current placement, and the page no longer presents it as a current ranking source.

sources.name: ExpeditionValues — current role / low-rarity stat cross-check
sources.whatChanged: None observed for the single record it supports.
sources.basis: Scoped to one unit's carry role and bottom-end output; not a roster-wide ranking input.

versionCheck.whatWasChecked: Whether a named Update 6 or a balance change superseding Hallows Eve existed as of 2026-11-10.
versionCheck.result: No Update 6 was found. Every current source still presents Update 5 · Hallows Eve as the live version, and the Halloween event window is still running (event codes expire 2026-11-14).
versionCheck.conclusion: The page may keep describing Hallows Eve as the current baseline, because that was verified rather than assumed.

whatChangedOnPage: Evidence snapshot moved from 2026-11-05 to 2026-11-08 after reconciling the November 8 revision.
The comparative baseline label changed from 'updated 2026-11-02' to 'updated 2026-11-08'.
The 'What Changed' section now records the re-read and the zero tier movement instead of only the Update 5 launch.
No unit tier was changed. No unit was added or removed.
whatDidNotChange: All 77 published five-view grades. The refresh corrected evidence dating and claim scope; it did not re-rank anything.
residualRisk: The page only proves current-ness up to the newest source revision it reconciled (2026-11-08). If the publisher advances that page again without a matching review, the snapshot date must move with it, not just lastModified.
rankingImpactSummary: No published tier moved. The November 8 revision added Emerald Fist (already published here at A, and A in the source) and refreshed evaluation detail; every one of the 75 reconciled placements still agrees.
